title: Patch: card versions and augments: Full art on many more cards, Animated and Signature on any version
notes: A card now wears one version, its normal face or the Full art version (Legendary, up from the full arts' Epic), and the augments layered on it, Animated (Epic) and Signature (Mythic), each a per-card cosmetic owned card by card like a foil and offered by data in the registry: every Rare and Epic Unit, every Legendary and Mythic card and the 21 full-art cards, 243 cards in every shipped set, Animated on all but the four Legacy cards, whose picture never moves (R2725000, R2725001, R2725003). A card pick names its version in `fullArt` and lists its `augments` (migration 0076); the server holds each part to ownership and the offer, a 400 otherwise, freezes it in the loadout and shows it to the other seat. The 84 full arts before it are retired: kept by their owners, dropped, sold and offered by nothing, and each counts as owning the version and augments it combines on its card, so a pick made before looks as it did (R2725002). Animated and Signature layer on the normal face and on Full art, the signature over the art window on the normal face (R2725003); the signature's ink is silver and its pen glow and burst white, clear of Radiant's gold (R2725004). The three new entries are granted to no account. How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Card versions and augments
new: Full art is now a version many more cards can wear: every Rare and Epic Unit and every Legendary and Mythic card. It is Legendary, rarer than before.
Animated (Epic) and Signature (Mythic) are now augments: earn one on a card and layer it on whichever version that card wears, its normal face too.
changes: A card's cosmetics in the Collection now pick a version, Normal or Full art, and toggle the Animated and Signature augments on top.
A full art you already own still counts: it gives you the Full art version and the augments it combined, on its card. The old full arts no longer drop.
The signature is now written in silver with a white pen glow, so it never looks like a Radiant card's gold.
